frequency_question: What proportion of fiscal policy amendments submitted for formal committee approval are completely processed and gazetted within 60 days of initial formal placement on the agenda?
membership_rule: Includes all proposed amendments to tax rates or financial service classifications formally tabled for discussion at apex committee meetings; excludes informal working group discussions that never reached formal agenda status.

cases.name: GST rate rationalization on electric vehicles (2019)
Correction of inverted duty structure on textiles (2021)
GST on online gaming and casinos (2023)

coverage_note: 5 named major structural tax amendment tracks analyzed; representative of high-priority fiscal revisions.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list minor administrative clarifications, focusing only on substantive rate or classification changes.
skeleton: Total formal major financial service or rate amendments tabled divided by those fully processed within two months.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 5 named prominent cases where rapid turnaround was attempted
validity_reason: Apex committee procedural rules and voting structures remain stable across multi-year electoral cycles.
